glosses: rout, hammering, trouncing, beating (the act of completely defeating an army or other enemy force, causing it to retreat in a disorganized manner; (by extension) in politics, sport, etc.: a convincing defeat)

examples.en: Are they going to beat me up?

examples.text: Dame tu dinero o te daré una paliza.
examples.en: Give me your money or else I'll beat you up.

examples.text: Le dimos una paliza al hombre.
Yo soy el que recibió la paliza.
examples.en: I'm the one who got beat up.
